The values preconfig- uredConfiguration and recommendedConfiguration are for documentation purposes and cannot be used for code generation.⌋() The element supportedConfigVariant is described in section 2.3.2 and sec- tion 2.3.4.3.2. To illustrate the structure of an ECU Conﬁguration Value description example 2.28 de- picts the top-level structure of an ECU Conﬁguration Value description XML ﬁle that conforms to the ECU Conﬁguration Deﬁnition XML ﬁle that was presented in exam- ple 2.6. Please note that it is allowed to have an arbitrary number of packages before a module package deﬁnition (e.g. /AUTOSAR/Ecuc_VendorX/CanIf/...).
